name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Heavy Leather

meta.wiki: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Heavy Leather

summary: In the Searing Gorge, Master Smith Burninate needs more fiery flux supplies. After What the Flux?, he asks you for two incendosaur scales, ten pieces of heavy leather, and coal. Bring all you can offer.

sections.title: Fiery Flux Wanted
sections.body: Master Smith Burninate needs more fiery flux in the Searing Gorge. The supply is running low, so he asks you for two incendosaur scales, ten pieces of heavy leather, and coal. Bring all you can offer.

faq.answer: Master Smith Burninate asks for the goods in the Searing Gorge and receives them in person.
Burninate wants two incendosaur scales, ten pieces of heavy leather, and coal.
Before this request, Burninate gave you What the Flux?.

faq.q: Why does Burninate want these goods?
faq.answer: Burninate says the fiery flux supply is running low and needs replenishing.
